title: Cookwala Advice (reasoning requests and responses)
description: Questions a robot, appliance, agent or person asks the Cookwala reasoner (what can I cook, how do I fix this mistake, how do we split the work, how do I store it, what should I cook for N people), and the structured, safety-checked answers. Served statelessly by the index (POST /v1/advise/{intent}) and with full kitchen context by a hub (POST /cookwala/v1/advise/{intent}). Use $defs AdviceRequest and AdviceResponse.

name.description: Free text when the id is unknown; the reasoner resolves it.

state.description: e.g. raw, cooked, frozen, overripe, stale.

iddsiLevel.description: IDDSI texture level for swallowing needs.

medical.description: e.g. low_sodium, diabetic, renal (used only for filtering, never stored).

useFirst.description: Inventory item ids or ingredient ids to prioritise (expiring).

holdMax.description: Longest acceptable time between done and served.

Context.description: What the asker knows about its kitchen. A hub fills this automatically; robots asking the index directly send what they have.

altitudeM.description: Affects boiling point, baking and pressure-cooking times.

profiles.description: Client, kitchen, cookware, robot and organization profiles to apply (resolved by the hub; private profiles never leave it).

catalogs.description: Recipe catalogs to search, in priority order (public, private, local).

extensions.description: Extension ids to apply to this request (filters, rankers, advisors).

members.description: Only when asking a local hub/advisor; the public index rejects requests containing person data.

type.description: From vocab/incidents (cw.incident.*), e.g. cw.incident.too_salty, cw.incident.scorched_bottom, cw.incident.emulsion_broke, cw.incident.time_temp_abuse.

media.description: Local references to photos/frames (kept local unless the user opts in).

Query.description: Intent-specific parameters. See the per-intent definitions below.

pantryStaplesAssumed.description: Assume salt, pepper, oil, water, common spices.

requester.description: Actor id of the robot asking (it gets the coordinator role if no hub).

helpers.description: Actor ids that offered help (from cookwala.team.bid).

allowSplitTasks.description: Split divisible work (chopping 2 kg onions) across actors.

duration.description: How long it must keep, e.g. P3D.

notCookedYet.description: True: also advise how to cook it for storage (cook-for-storage changes).

meals.description: Number of meals to cover (e.g. 9 for three days × three meals).

includeStorage.description: Plan make-ahead + storage for later meals.

limitingIngredient.description: Scale to what I have of this.

text.description: Natural-language question (required for intent=ask; optional extra context otherwise).

answersTo.description: Answers to questions from a previous needs_input response: {questionId: value}.

rulesApplied.description: Policy-pack rule ids and knowledge ids (e.g. cw.safety.tcs_4h, us.fda-food-code-2022/3-501.19).

target.description: Node id, ingredient ref or intermediate ref.

anyOf.description: Template placeholder, only in playbooks; resolved before a patch is applied.

PatchOp.description: One semantic change. In knowledge playbooks, string values may contain {placeholders} (e.g. {nodeId}, {salt_ratio}) that the reasoner resolves from the incident, answers and recipe.

RecipePatch.description: A semantic, validated change to a recipe's process graph (not raw JSON Patch), applied by the hub to the running session.

resumeAt.description: Node id to continue from after the patch.

redo.description: Completed nodes whose outputs are invalidated and must be redone.

validated.description: Patched graph passed schema + semantic validation + policy.

ref.description: recipeId#nodeId, or recipeId#nodeId/part-k for split tasks.

separateComponents.description: Store apart (sauce, crispy toppings, dressing, garnish).

cookForStorage.description: Changes when cooking specifically for storage (undercook pasta, hold back garnish...).

label.description: What to write on the label: name, date cooked, use-by, allergens, reheat instructions.

coverage.description: For cook_from: how the recipe matches what's available.

sensor.description: A robot can answer by measuring this sensor instead of asking a human.

resolvedIntent.description: For intent=ask: what the question was understood as.

safety.description: Overall verdict. If unsafe_discard, no option may keep the unsafe food.

PortionPlan.description: Right amount for each person from a dish or menu, so everyone meets their targets and nothing is wasted.

dayProgress.description: Share of the person's daily targets covered after this meal (0..1 per nutrient).

modifications.description: e.g. 'serve before adding salt', 'IDDSI 5 minced', 'no sauce'.

cookQuantityFactor.description: Scale to cook so total portions + planned leftovers are exact.

personIds.description: Members of the client profile (resolved locally by the hub).

recipeIds.description: Portion these dishes; omit to get a meal plan.
